title: Portfolio journal
description: The personal book behind the Vault wall. Closed lines carry their fill and PnL. Open lines may carry a mark (mtm_*); the page shows a dash and keeps the line Open until the journal has one. No broker mark is pulled by the page.

as_of_ct.description: Journal stamp. The week strip totals the ISO week of this date.

stop_stock.description: Stock stop for the line. Shown on open lines when present.

target_stock.description: Stock target for the line. Shown on open lines when present.

exit_ts_ct.description: Fill stamp. The week strip reads the date at the front.

mtm_price.description: Mark for a line still held, per contract or spread. Optional; leave out or null when not marked.

mtm_pnl_usd.description: Mark PnL in dollars for a line still held. Optional; never folded into the closed total.

mtm_as_of_ct.description: When the mark was taken, Central time, e.g. 2026-10-30 3:00 PM CT. Optional.
